environment.description: Lambda function deployed within VPC (vpc-0a3f8e2c) attached to private subnets (subnet-0b1c2d3e in us-east-1a, subnet-0f4g5h6i in us-east-1b). Subnet route tables (rtb-0x9y8z7w) contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) with no NAT gateway, no NAT instance, no VPC endpoints for any service, and no internet gateway route. Security group (sg-0j1k2l3m) allows inbound from API Gateway VPC endpoint only (pl-02cd2c6b for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api) on port 443, egress rule allows all traffic to 10.0.0.0/16 only. Network ACL (acl-0n4o5p6q) on both subnets has explicit DENY on all outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 (rule 50) before the default allow-all rule (rule 100), inbound allows only established connections from VPC CIDR.

config.internet_gateway: not attached to route table for these subnets
config.security_group: sg-0j1k2l3m: ingress 443 from pl-02cd2c6b, egress all to 10.0.0.0/16
config.network_acl: acl-0n4o5p6q: outbound DENY 0.0.0.0/0 rule 50, inbound allow 10.0.0.0/16 established
